parsed.why: No active state facility ban; two cities protect restrooms and hate-crime law covers gender identity. National passport/entry/custody remains; local ID restrictions are chiefly resident-facing.
Enforced birth-sex facility rule across state buildings including airports, one arrest, criminal trespass, adult/minor care barriers, elevated violence, and weak state recourse.
New effective birth-sex facility/ID law with criminal penalties and private bounty suits directly exposes visitor transit through public buildings despite public-accommodations protection.
Anti-trans statutes repeatedly blocked; no active facility or care ban, courts protect identity documents, and employment/contractor rules help—national border/passport exposure persists.

Broad public-accommodations protection, care shield law, gender-congruent custody, hate-crime and anti-discrimination enforcement materially reduce local exposure; national passport/entry/custody risks remain.
